style.backgroundSystem: flat solid graphic planes only, one dominant plane per screen switching between deep indigo #0A2A5C carrying a fine combed water-ripple grain, vermilion #C3160C, mandarin #FF8F39 and paper-white #FFFFFF card faces; every photograph sits inside a heavy rounded-corner paper-white #FFFFFF card keyed with a thick mandarin outline #FF8F39; two-plane screens are divided by one curved die-cut seam drawn with a thin mandarin keyline, never by a straight hairline rule and never by a torn paper edge; one extruded flat-shaded mandarin block #FF8F39 with a lighter #FFAF72 side face is the only pseudo-3D device; a pleated radial fan silhouette #0A2A5C sits low-opacity in one top corner; no wet stone slab, no rice-paper fibre band, no celadon glaze field, no wood-grain wall plane, no marble, no gradient glow, no landscape scenery
style.direction: high-contrast Chinese nine-chao flat color-block detail-page commerce, solid indigo-vermilion-mandarin panels framing real food photographs
style.iconSystem: solid silhouette ornaments only: 45-degree rotated diamond chips #C3160C with a thin mandarin #FF8F39 keyline, solid indigo #0A2A5C disc badges ringed in mandarin, pleated radial fan silhouettes, one bracketed cloud-scroll line motif, and one repeating chevron strip band #FF8F39 where two colour fields meet; blank photo-slot frames and blank pill bars count as layout devices, not illustrations; no hand-drawn botanical sketch, no dashed hairline rule, no hairline right-angle square frame, no outline-only icon, no seal, shield or stamp emblem
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5400K to 5500K soft studio light from the upper left, one large diffused key with a white bounce card on the shadow side, matte low-specular read on dry pieces, one honest soft contact shadow grounding every dish, spoon and card, flat even illumination across the solid colour planes so no cast falls onto them, no cool blue north-light cast, no warm amber cast, no hard specular hotspot, no plastic gloss sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-contrast Chinese nine-chao flat color-block ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a deep indigo plane #0A2A5C with a fine combed water-ripple grain, a vermilion plane #C3160C, a mandarin plane #FF8F39 and paper-white #FFFFFF card faces; neutral daylight-balanced 5400K to 5500K soft studio light from the upper left with a white bounce fill, matte low-specular read on dry pieces and one honest soft contact shadow grounding every dish, spoon and card, never a cool blue cast, never a warm amber cast; flat solid planes only, one dominant plane per screen, photographs set inside heavy rounded-corner paper-white cards keyed with a thick mandarin outline #FF8F39, two-plane screens divided by one curved die-cut seam with a thin mandarin keyline, one extruded flat-shaded mandarin block #FF8F39 with a lighter #FFAF72 side face as the only pseudo-3D device, a low-opacity pleated radial fan silhouette #0A2A5C in one top corner, no wet-stone or rice-paper ground, no celadon field, no wood-grain wall plane, no gradient glow, no scenery, no torn paper edge; one heavy Chinese sans-serif hei-ti for every headline and label placeholder plus one dry-brush calligraphy mark reserved for the opening screen, lettering always set as solid fills inside solid chips and never as thin outlines; ornament is solid silhouette only, namely 45-degree rotated diamond chips #C3160C with a thin mandarin keyline, solid indigo disc badges ringed in mandarin, pleated fan silhouettes, one bracketed cloud-scroll motif and one repeating chevron strip band #FF8F39, no hand-drawn botanical sketch, no dashed hairline rule, no hairline right-angle square frame, no vertical caption column, no seal or shield emblem; the plain paper-white porcelain dish with a narrow flat rim recurs at constant scale as the identity anchor alongside a matte charcoal-black stoneware bowl #1B1D22, a pale beech spoon #C69A64, sun-weathered pale grey timber slats #8A7A66 and fresh green lotus pods #6E8C3E, while dry pieces read hard, chalky-matte and pale ivory with one open split cleft, never glossy, never plastic; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no introduction of a fifth hue, no wet-stone or rice-paper ground, no celadon or misty-blue field, no warm wood backdrop
no mixed fonts and no Ming-style serif or script used as the display face, no handwritten body copy, no latin brand lettering
no vertical caption column, no hairline right-angle square frame, no dashed hairline rule, no torn or wavy paper edge, no hand-drawn botanical sketch, no seal or shield emblem
no outline-only iconography and no thin keyline captions: every chip, badge and pill is a solid colour fill with paper-white or indigo lettering
no inconsistent lighting, no cool blue or warm amber cast, no missing contact shadow, no floating dish, no floating piece
no glossy wet sheen on dry pieces, no plastic-looking food, no bleached uniform white, no mould spot, no insect or foreign matter, no tower of stacked pieces
no visible brand mark, water-mark, QR code, membership badge, promotional corner tag or contact detail
no printed origin or place name, grade or size term, net weight, piece count, soaking or cooking duration, nutrition figure, test result, certification, shelf life or efficacy wording
style.presentationRules: the same plain paper-white porcelain dish recurs as the identity anchor at constant scale; dry pieces always read hard, chalky-matte and pale ivory with one open split cleft and a faint grey-green trace inside the cleft, never glossy, never bleached to plastic white, never wet-looking; fresh kernels read smooth, round and pale jade-green only while seated in the pod face; shell dust and hull fragments appear only as a small quantity of pale debris in the sorting screen; pieces stay in one loose layer or a natural shallow mound, never stacked into a tower and never suspended in mid-air without a contact shadow; text never crosses a piece; one dominant colour plane per screen
style.surfaceSystem: plain paper-white glazed porcelain dish #FFFFFF with a narrow flat rim and no stud or beading, matte charcoal-black stoneware bowl #1B1D22, one long-handled pale beech spoon #C69A64, sun-weathered pale grey timber slats #8A7A66 as the only photographic table surface, slate-blue striped cotton cloth #7C8B9E, one clear straight glass tumbler #DCE4EA, fresh green lotus pods #6E8C3E with ivory-green kernels still seated in the pod face, one cut pale pod stem #C3CF9F, one dried pale pod shell #A9926B, a few scarlet goji berries #B3341E, cinnabar label chips #C3160C, mandarin keylines #FF8F39
style.typography: one heavy Chinese sans-serif hei-ti for every headline and label placeholder, with one dry-brush calligraphy mark reserved for the opening screen only; lettering sits as solid fills, never as thin outlines: paper-white #FFFFFF or deep indigo #0A2A5C characters set inside solid vermilion #C3160C and solid indigo shapes; headline 30-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 12-14pt, one glyph only per diamond or disc chip; every rendered word is a placeholder; no Ming-style serif used as the display face, no handwritten body copy, no latin brand lettering, no vertical caption column, no dense paragraph text
